title: 6 Truck Brands Winning and Losing the Sales War Right Now
description:
One truck company gained more than fifty-five thousand sales in a single year. Another lost almost fifty-three thousand. And the whole American pickup market barely moved. How can the total stay flat while the winners and losers change places? This is the real story of the truck brand war in twenty twenty-six.

Get the 2027 Truck Buyer's Guide: [LINK HERE]

Chapters:
0:00 Intro
2:28 1. Stellantis (Ram and Jeep)
4:39 2. Ford
6:55 3. General Motors
8:33 4. Toyota
9:35 5. Nissan
10:35 6. Honda and Hyundai
15:04 The big picture
19:23 What to check before you buy in 2027

Sources:
Stay with me, because there is a twist in every one of these stories. The biggest gain came from a truck brand that was supposed to be in trouble. The biggest loss came from the brand that has led America for decades. One company is celebrated for a truck that sold thirteen units. And one brand is quietly losing a third of its buyers. Every number comes from a published source, listed in the description.
